title: Book III
coreMove: Make haste by choosing clear judgment now, not by rushing more activity.
sourcePressure: Understanding may fail before life ends, so perception and ready principles must be trained before praise, pleasure, and curiosity waste the remaining time.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: urgency as panic or speed for its own sake

sourceAnchors.name: ripe figs and bent grain
sourceAnchors.detail: Book III trains perception through ripe figs, bent grain, old age, and other natural consequences that still belong to beauty.
sourceAnchors.phrasingHint: The ripe fig teaches the eye to see consequence without flinching from it.

sourceAnchors.name: physician's tools
sourceAnchors.detail: Book III ends by urging principles kept ready like a physician's tools.
sourceAnchors.phrasingHint: A principle left in storage is no more useful than an instrument sealed outside the operating room.

counterintuition: what looks like control is actually surrender
the real problem is not outside you
tryThisNow: write down what you can control
examples: generic office meeting with laptop and coffee
parent-child bedtime conflict repeated across chapters

exampleOpeningDiversity.rule: no more than 2 of the 6 examples may open with the pattern 'At HH:MM, <Name> <verb>s'
exampleOpeningDiversity.requiredOpenings: at least 4 distinct opening devices across the 6 examples, drawn from: timestamp+name+action, dialogue first line, sensory detail first, second-person direct address, retrospective recognition, question-as-hook, environmental detail before any human
exampleOpeningDiversity.rationale: C8 catches Cartesian repetition of phrases but not the deeper template of 'timestamp + named protagonist + prop + decision' that makes 6 examples feel like 1 example with name swaps

exampleSpecs.audience: Rachel cutting a documentary before the festival lock
exampleSpecs.stakes: another week of polishing could hide fear of final judgment
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Rachel deletes three beautiful but evasive shots and exports the cut before fatigue blurs the decision.
exampleSpecs.firstImage: The edit bay is dark except for the timeline bar blinking at 01:47:22.

exampleSpecs.audience: Mathieu taking his father to a memory clinic
exampleSpecs.stakes: delay could cost the family the last clear planning window
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Mathieu stops explaining away missed bills and books the assessment while his father can still choose.
exampleSpecs.firstImage: A stack of unopened envelopes leans against the sugar bowl.

exampleSpecs.audience: Grace learning when to harvest bruised fruit
exampleSpecs.stakes: she mistakes unblemished appearance for real readiness
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: The grower has Grace cut open a speckled pear and a glossy hard one, then choose by the flesh.
exampleSpecs.firstImage: "Pretty skin is not ripeness," Mr. Lowell says, handing Grace the knife.

exampleSpecs.stakes: reading one more article has become avoidance of the actual filing
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: At 9:05 p.m., Sam closes the last browser tab and drafts the client declaration while the facts are still clear.
exampleSpecs.firstImage: At 9:05 p.m., Sam watches the cursor blink under Statement of Facts.

exampleSpecs.audience: Nicolas deciding whether to turn around a practice climb
exampleSpecs.stakes: ambition makes worsening weather look negotiable
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: You watch Nicolas call the turn before the ridge, then see the fog erase the route ten minutes later.
exampleSpecs.firstImage: You can smell wet rope before the ridge disappears.

exampleSpecs.audience: Laura correcting a section before performance week
exampleSpecs.stakes: kindness has become avoidance of the hard note work
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: It took Laura two rehearsals to see that postponing correction was using up the choir's last good hour.
exampleSpecs.firstImage: It took Laura two rehearsals to hear the same flat entrance as a clock.

rhythmVariety.deepReadParagraphLengthMix: at least one paragraph 3 sentences or shorter, at least one paragraph 5+ sentences, at least one one-sentence punch line
rhythmVariety.fullReadInterludeRequirement: at least one paragraph that breaks the scene-then-rule rhythm: a question to the reader, a research aside, a direct second-person passage, or a brief historical reference
rhythmVariety.forbiddenRhythm: every paragraph following the pattern 'concrete anchor sentence -> abstract rule sentence -> elaboration sentence'

skillTargets: apply ready principles before praise or curiosity steals time

tryThisNowSpec: Look at one delayed duty and ask what faculty may weaken if you keep postponing it, then do the first clean step.
